description: Which actions are waiting for a human decision? Read held actions (pending by default, or another requested state) and their exact calls; this tool cannot decide or resubmit them. This also expires overdue held actions in the project and clears their stored request paths and bodies. Approving or rejecting a held action is done by a person with an approver key in the dashboard, by design. No MCP tool can approve actions.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_list_actions
title: List held actions
